rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a physical feeling or perception.

example.english: My hand is numb, so I can barely feel any sensation.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zek3 sau2 maa4 bei3 mou5 mat1 gam2 gok3

rows.note: Use this for widespread public excitement or interest caused by an event.

example.english: The film caused a sensation throughout the city as soon as it was released.
example.traditional: 套戲一上映就轟動全城。
example.jyutping: tou3 hei3 jat1 soeng6 jing2 zau6 gwang1 dung6 cyun4 sing4
